resources.zh_note: 当前跳转到 Nura，用于确认迁移后的现行入口；不代表任意手机都有镜像。
resources.en_note: Currently redirects to Nura and identifies the current entry point; it does not mean every phone has an image.

resources.zh_note: 按设备代号查状态与设备页；自动访问可能被 Anubis 拦截，需要人工浏览。
resources.en_note: Finds status and pages by device codename; Anubis may require manual browser review.

resources.zh_note: 包含设备包、内核和构建定义；仓库存在不等于某台手机功能完整。
resources.en_note: Contains device packages, kernels and build definitions; repository presence does not prove complete phone functionality.

zh.stage: 生态仍在运行，入口正迁移到 Nura；设备资料和代码可找到，但尚未逐机型核验。
zh.usable: 只有当前设备页明确列出准确代号、安装路径和功能状态时，才适合进入试装准备；不是通用刷机教程。
works_for: 当前设备目录明确列出的准确设备代号
有对应安装页或构建包，并具备原厂恢复资料的闲置手机
not_for: 零售名称相近但设备代号不同的机型
设备页未列出或核心功能状态未知的手机
依赖稳定通话、相机、定位等全部日常功能的主力机
zh.value: 用来判断旧手机是否存在 Linux 路线，以及功能缺口在哪里；价值是设备筛选，不是成功保证。
zh.follow: 知道设备代号、愿意读功能矩阵并能恢复原厂系统时继续；只知道品牌型号时先停。

en.stage: The ecosystem is active while entry points move to Nura. Device material and code remain available, but model-by-model review is incomplete.
en.usable: Proceed only when a current device page names the exact codename, install route and feature state. This is not a universal flashing guide.
works_for: Exact codenames listed in the current device directory
Spare phones with a matching install page or build package and a documented stock recovery route
not_for: Similar retail names with a different codename
Phones absent from the directory or with unknown core-function status
Daily-driver use requiring reliable calls, camera, positioning and every stock function
en.value: Helps determine whether an older phone has a Linux route and where functionality is missing. Its value is triage, not a success guarantee.
en.follow: Continue if you know the codename, accept feature-matrix review and can restore stock firmware; pause if you only know the retail name.

resources.zh_label: 官方支持清单与安装文档
resources.en_label: Official support list and install documentation
resources.zh_note: 列出支持设备、各主板安装入口、内部/外部刷写和安全警告，应从这里确认准确板号。
resources.en_note: Lists supported devices, board-specific routes, internal/external flashing and safety warnings; start with the exact board.

resources.zh_note: 用于获取和构建源码与镜像；适合核对构建流程，不是兼容清单。
resources.en_note: Fetches and builds source and images; useful for build review, but not a compatibility list.

resources.zh_note: 解释项目代码分别存放在哪里，用于确认上游仓库与镜像关系。
resources.en_note: Explains where project code is hosted and distinguishes upstream repositories from mirrors.

zh.stage: 上游项目与文档较完整，存在明确支持设备和安装路线；KitAgain 尚未整理全部板号。
zh.usable: 当前官方清单中的准确主板可进入安装评估；部分可内部刷写，部分必须使用外置编程器。
works_for: 官方列出的 ThinkPad X200/T400/T500/W500/R400/R500
当前支持清单中的特定 Chromebook、服务器、台式机和工作站板号
not_for: 同系列但未出现在当前支持清单的主板修订
已移除板卡或只有旧教程、没有当前 ROM 的设备
无法确认闪存芯片、备份和外部恢复条件的机器
zh.value: 支持清单足以帮助用户判断板号、刷写方式和恢复工具；主要不确定性是固件写入风险。
zh.follow: 能确认主板、完整备份闪存并准备恢复工具时继续；无法承担变砖风险时不要开始。

en.stage: The upstream project and documentation are substantial, with explicit supported devices and install routes; KitAgain has not normalized every board.
en.usable: Exact boards in the current official list can enter installation assessment. Some support internal flashing; others require external hardware.
works_for: Official ThinkPad X200/T400/T500/W500/R400/R500 routes
Official X220/X220T/T420/T420s/T520 and X230/T430/T530/W530/X230T routes
Exact Chromebook, server, desktop and workstation boards in the current list
not_for: Board revisions absent from the current list despite a similar family name
Removed boards or devices with only old instructions and no current ROM
Machines whose flash chip, backup and external recovery path cannot be confirmed
en.value: The support list can support a real board, flashing and recovery decision. Firmware-writing risk is the main issue.
en.follow: Continue if you can identify the board, back up the complete flash and prepare recovery hardware; stop if you cannot accept a non-booting machine.

resources.zh_note: 长期更新的 rootfs、内核和安装讨论入口；需要同时阅读首帖与近期回复。
resources.en_note: Long-running rootfs, kernel and installation entry; read both the first post and recent replies.

resources.zh_label: 设备与 U-Boot 讨论帖
resources.zh_note: 包含具体设备的启动、U-Boot 和恢复讨论；自动抓取可能返回 403。
resources.en_note: Contains device-specific boot, U-Boot and recovery discussion; automated fetching may return 403.

zh.stage: 社区长期维护，但知识分散在论坛首帖和多年回复中，不是统一安装包。
zh.usable: 核对准确型号、SoC、原厂 U-Boot、串口、NAND 布局和当前 rootfs 后，可作为高级改造路线。
works_for: 有专门主帖或确认启动记录的 Kirkwood 设备
NSA325、GoFlex Home、部分 Pogoplug 与 Synology 型号可作为逐帖核查起点
具备 USB-TTL、启动日志和闪存备份的闲置 NAS
not_for: 把所有 Kirkwood NAS 当成同一型号
跨品牌或 NAND 布局互换 U-Boot 环境变量
没有串口、没有备份且存有唯一数据的设备
zh.value: 能为停服或原系统过旧的 NAS 提供 Debian、内核和启动链线索，最大价值是型号专属恢复经验。
zh.follow: 有串口工具、Linux 基础并能先备份数据和闪存时继续；只想一键刷机时不要跟做。

en.stage: The community has maintained this route for years, but knowledge is spread across first posts and long reply chains rather than one installer.
en.usable: It becomes an advanced route only after verifying the exact model, SoC, stock U-Boot, serial access, NAND layout and current rootfs.
works_for: Kirkwood devices with a dedicated thread or confirmed boot report
NSA325, GoFlex Home and selected Pogoplug or Synology models as thread-review starting points
Spare NAS devices with USB-TTL, saved boot logs and flash backups
not_for: Treating every Kirkwood NAS as the same model
Mixing U-Boot environment values across brands or NAND layouts
Devices with no serial access, no backup and irreplaceable data
en.value: Provides Debian, kernel and boot-chain clues for unsupported NAS hardware; model-specific recovery experience is its strongest value.
en.follow: Continue with serial tools, Linux experience and complete backups; do not follow it if you need a one-click installer.

resources.zh_note: 说明原 Pebble 服务消失后如何切换到 Rebble，并链接当前设置流程。
resources.en_note: Explains the move from discontinued Pebble services to Rebble and links the current setup route.

resources.zh_note: 包含 Android/iOS 安装、配对、商店、天气、听写、订阅和退出 Rebble 等问题。
resources.en_note: Covers Android/iOS installation, pairing, store, weather, dictation, subscriptions and removing Rebble.

resources.zh_note: 用于查看生态内应用、服务与开发项目，不是单块手表的兼容证明。
resources.en_note: Lists ecosystem apps, services and development projects; it is not compatibility proof for one watch.

zh.stage: 社区服务已经可用，并有启用指南与帮助中心；旧应用、手机系统限制和新服务路线仍并行。
zh.usable: 很多 Pebble 手表可恢复应用商店和部分云服务，但需要可用的手机端应用；天气和听写可能依赖订阅。
works_for: 仍能开机和配对的 Pebble Classic、Steel、Time、Time Steel、Round 与 Pebble 2 系列可作为核查对象
能安装或侧载 Pebble 手机应用的 Android/iOS 用户
not_for: 假设所有新手机系统都能直接安装旧 Pebble 应用
假设所有原云功能都免费完整恢复
用云服务解决按键、屏幕或电池硬件故障
zh.value: 可判断旧 Pebble 还剩哪些软件价值、如何连接、哪些功能要订阅，以及去哪里排查问题。
zh.follow: 手表硬件正常且愿意处理手机侧兼容问题时继续；硬件损坏或不愿侧载应用时收益有限。

en.stage: Community services are usable with a setup guide and help center. Legacy apps, phone-OS limits and newer service routes still coexist.
en.usable: Many Pebble watches can regain the app store and selected cloud services, but a working phone app is required; weather and dictation may require a subscription.
works_for: Working Pebble Classic, Steel, Time, Time Steel, Round and Pebble 2 families as exact-device review candidates
Android or iOS users able to install or sideload the Pebble app
not_for: Assuming every new phone OS can directly install the legacy app
Assuming every former cloud function is restored completely and for free
Expecting cloud services to fix broken buttons, screens or batteries
en.value: Helps decide what software value remains, how connection works, which functions require subscriptions and where to troubleshoot.
en.follow: Continue if the watch hardware works and phone-side compatibility work is acceptable; value is limited for broken hardware or when sideloading is unacceptable.

resources.zh_label: 作者的 13 步安装教程
resources.zh_note: 包含 Android 上部署 Jellyfin 的完整过程和作者测试说法；缺少独立代码仓库与明确许可核验。
resources.en_note: Contains the Android Jellyfin setup and author test claims; an independently reviewed repository and clear license remain missing.

zh.stage: 有完整作者教程和多设备测试说法，但 KitAgain 尚未复现，也未确认脚本维护与许可证。
zh.usable: 可作为闲置 Android 设备运行轻量家庭媒体服务的实验；后台稳定、转码和重启恢复仍未知。
works_for: 作者报告测试过的多台 Motorola、Pixel 和 Fire Tablet，但尚无准确型号矩阵
主要承担直接播放、可长期接电并连接局域网的闲置 Android 设备
not_for: 需要可靠硬件转码、多用户高并发或公网暴露的服务器
Android 版本、CPU 架构和后台限制未核对的具体机型
存放唯一媒体副本或要求无人值守稳定运行
zh.value: 适合低成本验证旧手机能否当媒体服务器，并发现 Android 后台、存储和网络限制。
zh.follow: 有备用设备和媒体副本、能接受服务中断时继续；依赖稳定转码或唯一数据时选常规服务器。

en.stage: A complete author tutorial and multi-device claims exist, but KitAgain has not reproduced it or confirmed maintenance and licensing.
en.usable: It is an experiment for a spare Android device to host a light home media service; background reliability, transcoding and reboot recovery remain unknown.
works_for: Several Motorola devices, a Pixel and a Fire Tablet are author-reported, but no exact model matrix exists
Spare Android devices mainly serving direct-play media on a home LAN
not_for: Servers requiring dependable hardware transcoding, concurrency or public exposure
Models whose Android version, CPU architecture and background limits are unreviewed
Irreplaceable media or unattended long-term service
en.value: Useful for cheaply testing an old phone as a media server and exposing Android background, storage and network constraints.
en.follow: Continue with a spare device and copied media if interruptions are acceptable; use a conventional server for stable transcoding or unique data.

resources.zh_note: 包含 39 针屏幕、高压电源、v2 PCB、元件表、焊接问题和黑白输出进展。
resources.en_note: Documents the 39-pin panel, high-voltage rails, v2 PCB, components, soldering failures and black-and-white output.

resources.zh_note: 记录备用屏成功显示、ESP8266 内存与时序限制，以及首块屏可能损坏。
resources.en_note: Records successful output on a backup panel, ESP8266 memory/timing limits and likely damage to the first panel.

resources.zh_note: 含 gerber、pcb 和 src；README 说明代码拟用 MIT，但 PCB 与上游组件可能有其他许可。
resources.en_note: Contains gerber, pcb and src; the README proposes MIT for code while noting other possible PCB and upstream licenses.

zh.stage: v2 硬件曾正常产生电压，并在特定备用屏上得到黑白输出；灰阶和通用适配未完成。
zh.usable: 对能识别 39 针面板、会贴片焊接并理解正负高压的开发者有复刻价值；普通 Kindle 用户不能直接套用。
works_for: 项目实际使用的 39 针拆机电子纸面板及相同电气规格面板
ESP8266 或 STM32 控制实验，但需重查时序、RAM 和 PCB 修订
需要 Gerber、PCB 和驱动源码继续研究的开发者
not_for: 假设所有 Kindle 6 英寸屏或所有 39 针屏都兼容
不检查二极管方向、FPC 和修订就直接下单
完整灰阶、成品外壳或长期稳定显示
zh.value: 电源轨、连接器、PCB/代码和失败日志能减少逆向工作，但它不是即插即用产品。
zh.follow: 能读取面板编号、测量高压并自行审查 PCB 时继续；普通副屏需求应选完整方案。

en.stage: Revision 2 generated the intended rails and black-and-white output on a specific backup panel; grayscale and broad panel support are unfinished.
en.usable: Useful to developers who can identify a 39-pin panel, solder SMD parts and handle positive and negative high-voltage rails; not a drop-in Kindle route.
works_for: The tested 39-pin salvaged panel and panels with the same verified electrical specification
ESP8266 or STM32 experiments after rechecking timing, RAM and PCB revision
Developers needing Gerbers, PCB files and driver source
not_for: Assuming all six-inch Kindle or all 39-pin panels are compatible
Ordering without checking diode orientation, FPC soldering and revision
Complete grayscale, a finished enclosure or long-term stability
en.value: The power rails, connector, PCB/code and failure logs reduce reverse-engineering work, but this is not plug-and-play.
en.follow: Continue only if you can read the panel number, measure high voltage and review the PCB; choose a finished route for an ordinary second-screen need.

resources.zh_note: 说明 ED060SC4/类似屏与 Raspberry Pi 的目标，并明确两版 PCB 都有错误、无法修成可用。
resources.en_note: Explains the ED060SC4-or-similar Raspberry Pi goal and records two PCB revisions that could not be made usable.

resources.zh_note: 包含用途设想、元件与 PCB 过程，以及转向 L06 类似项目的原因。
resources.en_note: Contains intended uses, parts and PCB work, plus why the author moved toward the related L06 project.

zh.stage: 停在失败原型阶段：两版 PCB 均因设计错误不可用，作者转而参考另一块转接板。
zh.usable: 没有可以复刻并验收的成品，只适合作为失败资料、ED060SC4 研究入口和项目关系图。
works_for: 研究 ED060SC4 或相近电子纸接口的开发者
了解 Raspberry Pi 直接驱屏、PCB 设计和低功耗终端构想
查找 L06 等相邻方案
not_for: 任何 Raspberry Pi 与 Kindle 屏的可工作组合
直接下单、返修或连接两版失败 PCB
已实现太阳能笔记本、外壳、键盘或续航目标
zh.value: 明确记录哪些板子没工作、为什么停止以及应转向哪个项目，避免重复采购失败设计。
zh.follow: 只用于研究和失败复盘；找到后继修订与独立成功证据后再进入复刻。

en.stage: The project stopped at a failed prototype: two PCB revisions were unusable and the author moved toward another adapter.
en.usable: There is no buildable accepted result; it is a failure record, ED060SC4 research entry and project relationship map.
works_for: Developers researching ED060SC4 or similar e-paper interfaces
Studying direct Raspberry Pi panel drive, PCB design and low-power terminal concepts
Finding adjacent routes such as L06
not_for: Any claimed working Raspberry Pi and Kindle-panel combination
Ordering, patching or connecting either failed PCB revision
A completed solar laptop, enclosure, keyboard or battery-life goal
en.value: Records which boards failed, why work stopped and where the author turned next, preventing repeated purchases of a known-bad design.
en.follow: Use only for research and failure review; reproduce only after a successor revision and independent working evidence appear.

resources.zh_label: 11 英寸 Android 墙面板案例
resources.zh_note: 包含廉价平板、Fully Kiosk、MQTT/Node-RED、供电、随机 MAC、散热和持续充电讨论。
resources.en_note: Covers a cheap tablet, Fully Kiosk, MQTT/Node-RED, power, randomized MAC, cooling and continuous charging.

resources.zh_label: 墙面显示设备选型讨论
resources.zh_note: 比较旧手机、Android/iOS 平板、廉价 Lenovo、Xiaomi、Samsung OLED 平板和触屏笔记本。
resources.en_note: Compares used phones, Android/iOS tablets, a cheap Lenovo, Xiaomi, Samsung OLED tablet and a convertible laptop.

zh.stage: 这是多位用户的设备路线，不是单一项目；浏览器展示与 Kiosk 控制已有案例，长期安全仍需逐机验证。
zh.usable: 较新的旧平板或手机通常可作 Home Assistant 仪表板终端，适合显示和轻量控制，不等于适合隐藏式长期供电。
works_for: 社区建议约 2GB RAM 以上、较新 Android/iOS 和可用 WebView/浏览器的设备
帖子中的 11 英寸廉价 Android 平板能显示，但性能差且有随机 MAC 问题
Xiaomi 平板、Samsung OLED 平板和 iPad 9 等可作为进一步试用对象
not_for: 非常老的 WebView 或低内存设备流畅显示复杂仪表板
无充电上限、背部发热或电池老化的平板长期挂墙
ESP32 屏幕直接运行完整 Lovelace 网页
zh.value: 先用现有设备测试性能、Kiosk、断电恢复和充电策略，再决定墙体布线和支架。
zh.follow: 先在桌面连续试用；性能和充电限制合格后再上墙。鼓包、异常热或变形立即淘汰。

en.stage: This is a multi-user pattern rather than one project. Browser dashboards and kiosk control are demonstrated; long-term safety still needs device-specific checks.
en.usable: A reasonably recent spare tablet or phone can often serve as a Home Assistant dashboard terminal for display and light control, but that does not establish safe concealed continuous power.
works_for: Community guidance suggests roughly 2 GB RAM or more, recent Android/iOS and a usable WebView/browser
The reported cheap 11-inch Android tablet displays a dashboard but is slow and has randomized-MAC issues
Xiaomi tablets, a Samsung OLED tablet and iPad 9 are candidates for further trial
not_for: Very old WebView or low-memory devices rendering complex dashboards smoothly
Aged tablets without charge limits, with heat or worn batteries in permanent wall use
An ESP32 display running a full Lovelace web dashboard directly
en.value: Tests performance, kiosk behavior, power-loss recovery and charging before committing to wiring and a wall mount.
en.follow: Run it on a desk first; mount only after performance and charge limits pass. Retire swelling, unusually hot or deformed devices immediately.

resources.zh_label: Raspberry Pi 官方分步教程
resources.zh_note: 包含 Play:1 拆机、Pi 3 A+/Zero 2、4Ω 扬声器、DAC/功放、20V 供电、系统与音频测试，并有市电电容警告。
resources.en_note: Covers Play:1 disassembly, Pi 3 A+/Zero 2, 4-ohm drivers, DAC/amplifier, 20 V power, OS, audio tests and a mains-capacitor warning.

zh.stage: 教程形成完整作者构建路线，可复用 Play:1 箱体和扬声器；KitAgain 尚未复现或核对全部修订。
zh.usable: 故障或闲置 Play:1 可移除原主板并改成树莓派有源音箱；需要拆机、焊接、匹配功放和市电安全经验。
works_for: 扬声器单元正常的 Sonos Play:1 箱体与 4Ω 单元
教程使用的 Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+，以及明确提到的 Raspberry Pi Zero 2
能驱动 4Ω 单元的 DAC/功放组合和独立 20V 供电
not_for: 假设其他 Sonos 型号内部空间、阻抗和接线相同
保留原主板功能、Sonos 多房间协议或认证
没有市电设备安全经验的人处理原主板电容
zh.value: 完成度较高，能直接判断所需 Pi、功放、供电和软件步骤；核心价值是机械与电气路线。
zh.follow: 有焊接和市电安全经验且扬声器单元正常时继续；只想软件解锁或无法安全放电时不要尝试。

en.stage: The tutorial presents a complete author build reusing the Play:1 enclosure and drivers; KitAgain has not reproduced it or reviewed every revision.
en.usable: A failed or unused Play:1 can become a Raspberry Pi powered speaker after removing the original board. It requires disassembly, soldering, amplifier matching and mains safety.
works_for: A Sonos Play:1 enclosure with working 4-ohm speaker assembly
Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+ as used, with Raspberry Pi Zero 2 explicitly offered as an alternative
A DAC/amplifier for 4-ohm speakers and an isolated 20 V supply
not_for: Assuming other Sonos models share the same space, impedance and wiring
Retaining original mainboard functions, Sonos multi-room protocol or certification
Users without mains-equipment safety experience handling board capacitors
en.value: A relatively complete build that exposes the Pi, amplifier, power and software path; its main value is mechanical and electrical guidance.
en.follow: Continue with soldering and mains-safety experience when the drivers work; do not attempt it for software-only unlocking or without safe discharge handling.

resources.zh_label: 作者项目页与演示说明
resources.zh_note: 列出 ESP32、VS1053、外置天线、两套代码和视频演示，作者标记为 completed project。
resources.en_note: Lists ESP32, VS1053, external antenna, two code variants and a video demonstration; the author marks it completed.

resources.zh_label: 通用 VS1053 版本源码
resources.zh_note: 面向 ESP32-WROOM-32U 与通用 VS1053 板，用于核对引脚、依赖和配置。
resources.en_note: Targets ESP32-WROOM-32U and a generic VS1053 board for reviewing pinout, dependencies and configuration.

resources.zh_note: 包含接线、配置、库依赖和 Apache-2.0 许可证。
resources.en_note: Contains wiring, configuration, library dependencies and an Apache-2.0 license.

resources.zh_note: 用于听取作者演示；本轮确认链接，未做音质测量。
resources.en_note: Provides the author's demonstration; this review confirms the link without measuring audio quality.

zh.stage: 作者标记为完成，并给出两套源码、硬件组成和演示；KitAgain 尚未测量音质、延迟、噪声和稳定性。
zh.usable: 可把手机 A2DP 音频通过 ESP32+VS1053 输出到旧音响线路输入；更适合做外置接收盒。
works_for: ESP32-WROOM-32U、外置天线与通用 VS1053 MP3 板
普通 ESP32 加 Adafruit VS1053 breakout 的作者路线
有 AUX、Line In 等线路电平输入的旧音响
not_for: 只有喇叭端子、没有线路输入的无源音箱
ESP32 直接驱动大功率扬声器
低延迟视频同步、发烧级音质或所有蓝牙编码格式
zh.value: 能以可回退的外置盒方式给旧功放增加手机蓝牙输入，元件和源码路线清楚。
zh.follow: 音响有线路输入且能装配低压模块时继续；要求高保真、超低延迟或必须拆市电机箱时选成品接收器。

en.stage: The author marks it completed and provides two code variants, hardware components and a demo; KitAgain has not measured quality, latency, noise or stability.
en.usable: It can route phone A2DP audio through ESP32+VS1053 into an older stereo's line input, best as a reversible external receiver box.
works_for: ESP32-WROOM-32U with external antenna and generic VS1053 MP3 board
A regular ESP32 with the author's Adafruit VS1053 breakout route
Older stereos with AUX, Line In or another line-level input
not_for: Passive speakers with only speaker terminals
An ESP32 directly driving high-power speakers
Low-latency video sync, audiophile quality or every Bluetooth codec
en.value: Adds phone Bluetooth input to an old amplifier through a reversible external box with clear parts and source routes.
en.follow: Continue if the stereo has line input and you can assemble low-voltage modules; choose a finished receiver for high fidelity, very low latency or mains-enclosure work.

resources.zh_note: 页面说明目标、PRS-700、SD 卡假设、电池计划及仍未验证的关键问题。
resources.en_note: Describes the goal, PRS-700, SD-card hypothesis, battery plan and unresolved questions.

zh.stage: 作者计划让 Pico 改写 SD 卡上的 EPUB/PDF，使旧 Sony PRS-700 成为文本显示器；目前仍在研究和备料。
zh.usable: 现在只能作为旧阅读器文件注入思路，不能按此页面完成改造。
works_for: Sony PRS-700 这一作者研究对象
愿意分析 SD 卡读取行为的开发者
not_for: 需要即用信息屏的普通用户
把任意阅读器视为相同存储行为
zh.value: 清楚保存了一条避开屏幕高压驱动的替代思路，也明确暴露关键未知。
zh.follow: 想做协议研究可以继续；想要可靠显示应先选已有工作路线。

en.stage: The author plans to let a Pico rewrite EPUB/PDF files on an SD card so an old Sony PRS-700 can display changing text; the work remains at research and parts-gathering stage.
en.usable: It is currently an idea for file injection on an older reader, not a buildable conversion.
works_for: The author's Sony PRS-700 research target
Developers willing to characterize SD-card behavior
not_for: Users needing a ready information display
Assuming all readers access removable storage identically
en.value: Preserves a route that may avoid direct high-voltage panel driving while exposing the unresolved assumptions.
en.follow: Continue for protocol research; choose a demonstrated route for a dependable display.

resources.zh_note: 包含硬件复用目标、组件、论文、博客和飞控源码入口。
resources.en_note: Links the reuse goal, components, paper, blog and flight-controller source.

zh.stage: 作者把旧路由器、PIC、Wii 传感器、IP 摄像头和电机组合成低成本联网无人机平台，并公开论文、博客与飞控代码入口。
zh.usable: 可研究废旧路由器作为机载联网节点的系统思路，不适合作为当前即用无人机套件。
works_for: 旧 OpenWrt 类路由器与可替换传感器的实验
研究低成本空中网络的平台设计
not_for: 直接复制为可安全飞行的成品
未经法规和失效测试的户外飞行
zh.value: 把多类废件如何组成完整系统记录在一起，可用于架构与失败模式研究。
zh.follow: 做历史技术研究可继续；实际飞行应从当前受支持的飞控与安全链开始。

en.stage: The author combines old routers, PICs, Wii sensors, IP cameras and motors into a low-cost connected drone platform, with paper, blog and flight-controller links.
en.usable: Useful for studying a salvaged router as an airborne network node, not as a current ready-to-fly kit.
works_for: Experiments with older OpenWrt-class routers and replaceable sensors
Studying low-cost airborne-network architecture
not_for: Copying directly into a safe finished aircraft
Outdoor flight without regulatory and failure testing
en.value: Records how several waste-device classes can form one system and supports architecture and failure analysis.
en.follow: Continue for historical system research; use currently supported flight-control safety paths for real flight.

resources.zh_note: 说明静态文档、艺术图片、四种传输方式和 MIT 许可主张。
resources.en_note: Describes static documents, art display, four transfer methods and an MIT-license claim.

zh.stage: 项目用树莓派驱动闲置显示器，通过 SCP、共享目录、网页或 WebSocket 接收静态文档与艺术图片。
zh.usable: 架构和传输方式描述清楚，可作为工作台资料屏原型，但发布完成度不明。
works_for: 带标准视频输入的闲置 LCD 显示器
树莓派或其他能驱动显示器的小主机
not_for: 没有控制板的裸 LCD 面板
要求维护完善的一键部署
zh.value: 把显示器从普通副屏变成无鼠标干扰的专用资料屏。
zh.follow: 能自行维护 Linux 启动和传输脚本时值得试；否则使用成熟数字标牌软件。

en.stage: The project uses a Raspberry Pi with spare monitors and accepts static documents or art through SCP, shared folders, a web page or WebSocket.
en.usable: The architecture and transfer methods are clear enough for a workbench prototype, while release completeness is unclear.
works_for: Spare LCD monitors with standard video input
A Raspberry Pi or similar display-capable host
not_for: Bare LCD panels without controllers
Users needing a maintained one-click deployment
en.value: Turns a general monitor into a dedicated reference display without pointer or window-management friction.
en.follow: Worth trying if you can maintain Linux boot and transfer scripts; otherwise use maintained signage software.

resources.zh_note: 记录目标部件、替换主板、CM4 启动、PCB 和外设调试进展。
resources.en_note: Documents retained parts, replacement board, CM4 boot, PCB and peripheral progress.

zh.stage: 作者为 2010 年 iPad 设计 CM4 替换主板，目标复用外壳、电池、触摸、LCD、天线、扬声器和按键，并记录可启动系统。
zh.usable: 高级开发者可复用大部分原机结构做 Linux/Android 平板，普通用户仍缺少成熟套件。
works_for: 2010 年第一代 iPad 的作者硬件范围
有细间距焊接和 PCB 调试能力的开发者
not_for: 其他 iPad 代际直接套用
只想通过软件更新恢复现代应用
zh.value: 少见地尝试保留原机大量部件，而不是只把外壳当盒子。
zh.follow: 能审板、处理电池并接受高成本原型时继续；普通用户等待稳定硬件版本。

en.stage: The author designs a CM4 replacement board for a 2010 iPad to reuse the enclosure, battery, touch, LCD, antennas, speaker and buttons, with a reported booting system.
en.usable: Advanced builders may reuse much of the original structure for Linux/Android, while no mature consumer kit exists.
works_for: The author's 2010 first-generation iPad scope
Developers capable of fine-pitch soldering and PCB debug
not_for: Applying directly to other iPad generations
Users seeking a software-only route to modern apps
en.value: Unusually aims to retain many original components instead of using only the enclosure.
en.follow: Continue if board review, battery work and prototype cost are acceptable; others should wait for stable hardware.

resources.zh_note: 说明模块标准、主板/外设复用目标、BOM 与 PCB 修订兼容问题。
resources.en_note: Explains module standards, reuse goals, BOM and PCB-revision compatibility issues.

zh.stage: 项目提出开放的机械与电气模块标准，让平板的主板、屏幕、电池和外设可升级并跨机型复用。
zh.usable: 可作为可修复平板设计参考，尚不能让任意旧平板直接模块化。
works_for: 开发开放平板或工业终端的人
研究跨代复用屏幕、电池和外设接口
not_for: 直接升级现有 iPad 或 Android 平板
没有 PCB 和结构设计能力的快速改造
zh.value: 提供减少整机报废的模块化设计思路和迭代记录。
zh.follow: 做硬件平台研究值得继续；处理一台现有旧平板时选择对应机型项目。

en.stage: The project proposes open mechanical and electrical module standards so tablet boards, displays, batteries and peripherals can be upgraded and reused across form factors.
en.usable: Useful as a repairable-tablet design reference, but it cannot modularize an arbitrary old tablet.
works_for: People developing open tablets or industrial terminals
Research into cross-generation display, battery and peripheral reuse
not_for: Direct upgrades of existing iPads or Android tablets
Quick builds without PCB and mechanical-design capability
en.value: Provides a modular design approach and iteration record aimed at preventing complete-device disposal.
en.follow: Continue for platform research; use a model-specific project for one existing tablet.

resources.zh_note: 描述拆螺丝器、拆焊器、相机识别和基于 3D 打印机运动平台的阶段目标。
resources.en_note: Describes the de-screwer, desolderer, camera recognition and 3D-printer motion platform.

zh.stage: 团队在家用 3D 打印机运动机构上安装烙铁和相机，用机器视觉寻找焊点并尝试自动拆取元件。
zh.usable: 可研究如何把废旧打印机变成拆焊实验平台，不能视为自动回收机。
works_for: 结构仍能运动的 FDM 3D 打印机
已断电、已放电的简单手工焊接板实验
not_for: 复杂多层量产板的自动拆解
无人看护的高温运行
zh.value: 把元件再利用、视觉识别和旧运动平台连接成可观察的研究方向。
zh.follow: 有实验室安全条件和算法开发能力时继续；只需偶尔拆件时手工工具更合适。

en.stage: The team mounts a soldering iron and camera on a home 3D-printer motion system, using vision to find joints and attempt automated component removal.
en.usable: A research platform for turning an old printer into a desoldering experiment, not an automatic recycling machine.
works_for: FDM printers with functioning motion systems
Powered-off and discharged simple hand-soldered boards
not_for: Automatic processing of complex multilayer production boards
Unattended high-temperature operation
en.value: Connects component reuse, vision and a salvaged motion platform in an observable research path.
en.follow: Continue with lab safety and algorithm skills; use hand tools for occasional component recovery.

resources.zh_note: 说明低成本目标、旧打印机零件来源、加工工具和塑料循环路线。
resources.en_note: Describes the low-cost goal, salvaged printer parts, tools and plastic-recycling route.

zh.stage: 项目尝试用本地废塑料和从旧 3D 打印机回收的运动件，构建易制造的塑料再利用打印系统。
zh.usable: 适合有制作空间的人研究旧打印机零件和废塑料再利用，不是桌面即插即用设备。
works_for: 可回收步进电机、导轨等部件的旧 3D 打印机
能分类清洁塑料并加工框架的工作室
not_for: 混合或来源不明塑料直接熔融
家庭无人看护运行
zh.value: 同时处理旧机器部件和废塑料，且作者强调低工具门槛。
zh.follow: 有通风、防火和机械制造能力时研究；普通打印需求优先修复现有打印机。

en.stage: The project combines local waste plastic with motion parts salvaged from older 3D printers to create an accessible recycling/printing machine.
en.usable: Suitable for equipped makerspaces studying old-printer parts and waste plastic, not a plug-in desktop appliance.
works_for: Older printers yielding stepper motors, rails and related parts
Workshops able to clean plastic and fabricate a frame
not_for: Melting mixed or unknown plastics
Unattended home operation
en.value: Addresses both machine-part reuse and plastic waste with an emphasis on accessible tooling.
en.follow: Research with ventilation, fire protection and fabrication capability; repair an existing printer first for ordinary printing needs.

resources.zh_note: 包含 Nokia 3310 拆机、振动焊点、Arduino、继电器、代码和误触讨论。
resources.en_note: Includes Nokia 3310 disassembly, vibration pads, Arduino, relay, code and false-trigger discussion.

zh.stage: 作者从旧 Nokia 类手机振动电机焊点读取来电/短信触发，再由 Arduino 和继电器切换外部负载。
zh.usable: 在仍有兼容蜂窝网络时可做低压远程触发实验。
works_for: 带振动电机且仍可接入当地网络的旧功能机
低压、可安全失败的测试负载
not_for: 当地已关闭对应蜂窝制式
未经电气隔离的水泵和市电设备
zh.value: 展示无需数据网络也能复用旧手机通信链路。
zh.follow: 只在低压测试和严格白名单下继续；关键控制使用专用工业方案。

en.stage: The author reads call/SMS activity from an old Nokia-class phone's vibration-motor pads, then lets an Arduino and relay switch an external load.
en.usable: A low-voltage remote-trigger experiment where a compatible cellular network still operates.
works_for: Feature phones with a vibration motor and local network service
Low-voltage loads that fail safely
not_for: Regions where the required cellular generation is shut down
Pumps or mains devices without engineered isolation
en.value: Demonstrates reuse of an old phone's communication path without mobile data.
en.follow: Continue only with low-voltage tests and strict allowlisting; use industrial controls for critical loads.

resources.zh_note: 记录模块化换机思路、LED、菲涅尔镜、第一版原型和结构设计。
resources.en_note: Documents the swappable-host idea, LED, Fresnel optics, first prototype and enclosure work.

zh.stage: 作者把旧笔记本 LCD、主机和高功率 LED 组合成可更换笔记本核心的投影媒体中心，并记录第一版原型。
zh.usable: 适合光学和散热实验，不适合期望成品投影机体验的人。
works_for: LCD 和主板仍工作的旧笔记本
有光学、木工和散热设计能力的制作者
not_for: 屏幕本身破裂或严重漏光
需要安静、高亮、可靠家庭影院
zh.value: 展示整台旧笔记本而非单个零件的升级式复用结构。
zh.follow: 为学习光路可以继续；实际观影先比较修复或二手投影机。

en.stage: The author combines an older laptop LCD, host and high-power LED into a projector/media center designed around a swappable laptop core, with a first prototype documented.
en.usable: Suitable for optics and cooling experiments, not for users expecting a finished projector experience.
works_for: Older laptops with working LCD and motherboard
Builders with optical, woodworking and thermal-design skills
not_for: Cracked or badly damaged panels
Quiet, bright and dependable home cinema
en.value: Shows a structure that reuses a whole laptop and allows later host replacement.
en.follow: Continue to learn projection optics; compare repair or a used projector for regular viewing.

resources.zh_note: 说明 MK2002 字库 ROM、计数逻辑、七只 LED 和改板动机。
resources.en_note: Explains the MK2002 font ROM, counters, seven LEDs and the board modification.

zh.stage: 作者修改 DEC LA30 打印终端的字符发生器板，让计数器轮询字库并用七只 LED 显示点阵行数据。
zh.usable: 可作为数字逻辑和字库 ROM 教学作品，实用功能有限。
works_for: 相同 DEC LA30 字符板或同类可识别字库板
想观察旧 ROM 字符数据的学习实验
not_for: 通用打印机主板复用方法
需要实际打印或显示文字的成品
zh.value: 保留了一种从废板理解早期字符生成逻辑的做法。
zh.follow: 拥有同板且以学习为目标时跟进；普通废打印机先回收电机、导轨和电源。

en.stage: The author modifies a DEC LA30 terminal character-generator board so counters scan its ROM and seven LEDs expose dot-matrix row data.
en.usable: A digital-logic and font-ROM teaching artifact with limited practical function.
works_for: The same DEC LA30 character board or a similar identifiable ROM board
Learning experiments that expose old font data
not_for: A universal printer-mainboard reuse method
A finished device that prints or displays full text
en.value: Preserves a way to learn early character-generation logic from a discarded board.
en.follow: Follow if you own the same board and want to learn; for ordinary printers salvage motors, rails and supplies first.

resources.zh_note: 说明二十段色轮、摘挂机状态、五分钟变暗和成品演示。
resources.en_note: Describes the twenty-part color wheel, hook state, five-minute dimming and finished demonstration.

zh.stage: 作者在老 GTE 转盘电话中加入控制器和灯光，用拨号盘选择颜色，并保留听筒开关作为奇偶颜色控制。
zh.usable: 可把机械拨号盘和外壳复用为交互灯光作品。
works_for: 机构完好的脉冲拨号电话
愿意保留原外观的低压互动装置
not_for: 需要继续普通电话通话
未与外线彻底隔离的设备
zh.value: 提供保留机械手感而赋予新交互的轻量示例。
zh.follow: 能识别拨号触点并安全隔离时继续；收藏价值高的完整电话先考虑无损方案。

en.stage: The author adds control electronics and lighting to an old GTE rotary phone, using dial pulses for colors and the hook switch to select odd/even positions.
en.usable: Reuses the mechanical dial and enclosure as an interactive lighting object.
works_for: Pulse-dial phones with intact mechanics
Low-voltage interactive pieces retaining the original appearance
not_for: Continued ordinary telephone service
Devices not fully isolated from outside lines
en.value: A compact example of preserving tactile mechanics while giving the object a new interaction.
en.follow: Continue if dial contacts can be identified and isolated; prefer nondestructive work on collectible complete phones.

resources.zh_note: 包含 V1/V2 外壳、弹簧针 PCB、Gerber、零件和制作入口。
resources.en_note: Includes V1/V2 housings, pogo-pin PCBs, Gerbers, parts and build notes.

zh.stage: 项目为旧 Android 手机设计 3D 打印外壳、弹簧针 PCB、USB 2.0 和可换电池模块，已上传多份结构与 Gerber 文件。
zh.usable: 可作为单一手机的模块背板原型，尚不是通用 Phonebloks 系统。
works_for: 能找到 USB 与电池焊点的作者式 Android 手机改造
会 PCB、FPC 和 3D 打印适配的开发者
not_for: 不拆机即可适配任意现代手机
把不同手机电池直接互换
zh.value: 提供了比概念图更接近制造的机械和 PCB 文件。
zh.follow: 有备用机且能审查电源设计时继续；主力机不要作为首个样品。

en.stage: The project designs printed housings, pogo-pin PCBs, USB 2.0 and swappable battery modules for an older Android phone, with several mechanical and Gerber files uploaded.
en.usable: A modular-back prototype for one phone, not a universal Phonebloks ecosystem.
works_for: Android-phone experiments with accessible USB and battery points
Developers able to adapt PCBs, FPCs and printed housings
not_for: Tool-free support for arbitrary modern phones
Directly interchanging batteries across phone models
en.value: Provides mechanical and PCB files closer to fabrication than a concept rendering.
en.follow: Continue with a spare phone and power-design review; do not use a primary phone as the first sample.

resources.zh_note: 说明 USB OTG、键盘控制、DisplayLink、DVI-LVDS 和供电设想及未完成难点。
resources.en_note: Describes USB OTG, keyboard control, DisplayLink, DVI/LVDS and power ideas plus incomplete blockers.

zh.stage: 项目尝试保留旧笔记本屏幕、键盘和外壳，通过 USB OTG、DisplayLink、DVI/LVDS 转换让手机成为计算核心。
zh.usable: 有价值的是整合路线和难点清单，当前不能当作通用转换板。
works_for: 外壳、键盘和 LCD 完整但主板报废的特定笔记本
愿意处理多级视频转换和 USB 控制的开发者
not_for: 希望单根线连接任意手机和任意笔记本
电池、LCD 或排线状态未知的机器
zh.value: 把旧笔记本最难复用的键盘和屏幕接口问题集中呈现。
zh.follow: 做接口研究可继续；实用扩展坞应先确认一个完整型号组合。

en.stage: The project aims to retain an old laptop display, keyboard and enclosure while using USB OTG, DisplayLink and DVI/LVDS conversion around a phone as the compute core.
en.usable: Its main value is the integration route and difficulty map, not a universal conversion board.
works_for: Specific laptops with intact enclosure, keyboard and LCD but failed mainboards
Developers willing to solve layered video and USB control
not_for: One-cable support for arbitrary phones and laptops
Machines with unknown battery, LCD or cable condition
en.value: Concentrates the hardest laptop-part reuse problems: keyboard and display interfaces.
en.follow: Continue for interface research; prove one exact combination before pursuing a practical dock.

resources.zh_label: 作者完整制作与故障日志
resources.en_label: Complete author build and fault log
resources.zh_note: 含 MX Linux、Feh、VNC、结构步骤和未解决的 13.5 kHz 啸叫。
resources.en_note: Covers MX Linux, Feh, VNC, mechanical steps and the unresolved 13.5 kHz whine.

zh.stage: 作者拆出旧笔记本主板和屏幕，装入 12×18 英寸相框，用 MX Linux、Feh 和 VNC 自动播放照片。
zh.usable: 可以实际播放照片并远程维护，但高频噪声可能使成品不可接受。
works_for: 主板和 LCD 仍工作的旧 x86 笔记本
能运行轻量 Linux 并从 USB 启动的机器
not_for: 对高频噪声敏感的房间
裸板无防护的长期墙装
zh.value: 完整记录了成功功能和一个没有美化的真实缺陷。
zh.follow: 先整机测试噪声、温度和自动恢复；通过后再拆装进框。

en.stage: The author mounts an older laptop motherboard and display in a 12×18-inch frame, using MX Linux, Feh and VNC for an automatic slideshow.
en.usable: It can display photos and be maintained remotely, but high-frequency noise may make the result unacceptable.
works_for: Older x86 laptops with working motherboard and LCD
Systems able to boot lightweight Linux from USB
not_for: Rooms with listeners sensitive to high-frequency noise
Long-term wall mounting of unprotected boards
en.value: Documents both working function and a real unresolved defect without hiding it.
en.follow: Test noise, temperature and reboot recovery as a complete laptop before framing it.

resources.zh_label: 作者逆向与控制器日志
resources.zh_note: 记录具体键盘型号、矩阵、回收 STM32、USB 固件和连接器限制。
resources.en_note: Records the exact keyboard, matrix, recycled STM32, USB firmware and connector limits.

zh.stage: 作者为 Acer/eMachines MP-09B23U4-6983 键盘反查矩阵，并用回收的 STM32 制作 USB 键盘控制器。
zh.usable: 对准确型号可成为 USB 键盘，方法也适合学习矩阵逆向。
works_for: Acer MP-09B23U4-6983 / PK130C93A00 作者型号
可逐键测量矩阵和焊接 FPC 的开发者
not_for: 任意笔记本键盘直接插 USB
带复杂背光、触控或专用控制芯片但无资料的模块
zh.value: 保留手感好的旧键盘，并展示型号级逆向过程。
zh.follow: 型号相同可深入；型号不同先把它当新的矩阵测绘项目。

en.stage: The author reverse-maps an Acer/eMachines MP-09B23U4-6983 keyboard matrix and uses a salvaged STM32 as a USB keyboard controller.
en.usable: The exact model can become a USB keyboard, and the method teaches matrix reverse engineering.
works_for: The author's Acer MP-09B23U4-6983 / PK130C93A00 model
Developers able to probe matrices and solder FPC connections
not_for: Plugging an arbitrary laptop keyboard directly into USB
Undocumented modules with complex backlight, touch or dedicated controllers
en.value: Preserves a good keyboard feel and demonstrates model-specific reverse engineering.
en.follow: Investigate further for the same model; treat every other model as a new matrix-mapping project.

resources.zh_note: 包含测试旧机、拆喷嘴、改热封头和保持可逆性的提醒。
resources.en_note: Covers testing the old printer, removing the nozzle, fitting a sealer and preserving reversibility.

zh.stage: 教程利用仍能三轴运动并加热的 FDM 打印机，把喷嘴换成热封头，用于沿程序路径封合薄膜。
zh.usable: 作为可逆工装实验有明确步骤，适合闲置但运动系统正常的打印机。
works_for: 三轴和热端仍工作的 FFF/FDM 打印机
小批量薄膜封合实验
not_for: 食品、医疗或压力包装的合规密封
仍是主要生产工具且不愿停机的打印机
zh.value: 用现有运动控制和热端完成另一种可编程加工。
zh.follow: 先确保改装完全可回退并做破坏性样片测试；重要包装使用认证设备。

en.stage: The instructions reuse an FFF/FDM printer with working three-axis motion and heater, replacing the nozzle with a sealing tool that follows programmed paths.
en.usable: A documented reversible tooling experiment for an idle printer with a functioning motion system.
works_for: FFF/FDM printers with working axes and heater
Small-batch film-sealing experiments
not_for: Regulated food, medical or pressure-package seals
A primary production printer that cannot be taken offline
en.value: Uses existing motion control and heat for a different programmable process.
en.follow: Keep the conversion reversible and destructively test samples first; use certified equipment for important packaging.

resources.zh_label: Luggable PC 项目与屏幕日志
resources.en_label: Luggable PC project and display log
resources.zh_note: 记录 E1705 面板、控制板、分辨率问题、Mark I 完成和转向 Mark II。
resources.en_note: Documents the E1705 panel, controller, resolution issue, completed Mark I and move to Mark II.

zh.stage: 作者把显卡故障笔记本的 17 英寸 LCD 配专用控制板，与退役台式机零件组装成可搬运电脑，并完成 Mark I。
zh.usable: 同类 LCD 可通过匹配控制板成为标准视频显示器，并用于自制一体机。
works_for: Dell Inspiron E1705 的作者面板或有匹配控制板的 LCD
仍可用的退役 ATX/桌面部件
not_for: 只按尺寸购买控制板
希望轻薄和低功耗的便携电脑
zh.value: 包含面板控制板匹配和整机结构的实际经验。
zh.follow: 能读取精确面板型号并接受体积时继续；先台架点亮再做机箱。

en.stage: The author pairs a 17-inch LCD from a GPU-failed laptop with a model-specific controller and retired desktop parts to complete a luggable Mark I computer.
en.usable: A matching LCD can become a standard-video display and part of a custom all-in-one computer.
works_for: The author's Dell Inspiron E1705 panel or LCDs with matched controllers
Still-functional retired ATX/desktop components
not_for: Buying controllers by screen size alone
Users seeking a thin, low-power portable computer
en.value: Includes real experience matching a controller to a panel and integrating a complete system.
en.follow: Continue if the exact panel number is known and size is acceptable; bench-test before building an enclosure.

resources.zh_label: 项目页与六机复用日志
resources.zh_note: 描述六台屏幕拼接、PXE、主从节点、摄像头和同型号设备要求。
resources.en_note: Describes six tiled screens, PXE, master/worker nodes, camera and matching-device requirements.

zh.stage: 项目计划让六台相同旧笔记本通过 PXE 启动并把屏幕拼成窗格，用于城市间视频交流和艺术展示。
zh.usable: 可作为批量旧笔记本的网络启动拼屏实验，完成度仍需核实。
works_for: 尺寸和亮度接近的六台旧笔记本
能部署 PXE 和处理多节点视频的软件团队
not_for: 型号差异大且屏幕亮度不一致的随机设备
追求无边框或低功耗的正式显示墙
zh.value: 展示不拆面板也能通过网络协同复用整机的方法。
zh.follow: 手上有同批设备且用于艺术实验时继续；普通显示墙先核算能耗与维护。

en.stage: The project proposes PXE-booting six similar old laptops and arranging their screens as a window for inter-city video exchange and art display.
en.usable: A network-boot tiled-screen experiment for a batch of old laptops, with final completion still uncertain.
works_for: Six older laptops with similar size and brightness
Teams able to deploy PXE and multi-node video software
not_for: Random models with mismatched panels
A low-power or bezel-free production video wall
en.value: Shows how whole machines can cooperate over the network without extracting their panels.
en.follow: Continue for an art experiment with a matching batch; calculate power and maintenance for regular signage.

resources.zh_note: 包含 N97 键盘矩阵、Hirose 连接器、触摸测量、屏幕选择和 PCB 计划。
resources.en_note: Includes the N97 keyboard matrix, Hirose connector, touch probing, display choice and PCB plan.

zh.stage: 作者逆向 N97 键盘矩阵、FPC 和四线电阻触摸，计划用 Zero 形态 SBC、定制 PCB 与 3.2 英寸 HDMI 屏重建 Linux 掌机。
zh.usable: 目前是高质量逆向资料和局部原型，还不是可复制成品。
works_for: Nokia N97 外壳、键盘和触摸部件
能做细间距 PCB 与结构适配的开发者
not_for: 其他 Nokia 滑盖机直接套用
无需焊接的普通用户改造
zh.value: 已公开键盘矩阵和连接器识别，降低同机型继续研究成本。
zh.follow: 以逆向和定制板为目标值得跟进；想要成品掌机需等待完整版本。

en.stage: The author maps the N97 keyboard matrix, FPC and four-wire resistive touch, planning a Linux pocket computer with a Zero-form-factor SBC, custom PCB and 3.2-inch HDMI screen.
en.usable: Currently a strong reverse-engineering record and partial prototype, not a reproducible finished device.
works_for: Nokia N97 enclosure, keyboard and touch parts
Developers able to design fine-pitch PCBs and mechanical adapters
not_for: Applying directly to other Nokia sliders
A solder-free consumer conversion
en.value: Published keyboard mapping and connector identification lower the cost of continuing with this exact model.
en.follow: Worth following for reverse engineering and custom-board work; wait for integration if you need a finished pocket computer.

resources.zh_note: 包含表头测量、PWM/DAC 方法、校准思路和回收 Hi-Fi 元件场景。
resources.en_note: Covers meter characterization, PWM/DAC methods, calibration and salvaged Hi-Fi use.

zh.stage: 教程分析回收的 VU 表头灵敏度，并比较 PWM 与 DAC 驱动，让指针显示树莓派负载或音频状态。
zh.usable: 可把旧音响指针表变成低速状态仪表，教程对新手较友好。
works_for: 可独立取出的模拟 VU 表或低压表头
树莓派 PWM/DAC 状态显示
not_for: 未知量程下直接接 3.3V/5V
要求精密快速测量的仪器
zh.value: 帮助用户先测参数再复用，而不是凭外观接线。
zh.follow: 能测量灵敏度并限流时继续；稀有原机优先无损修复。

en.stage: The tutorial measures salvaged VU-meter sensitivity and compares PWM and DAC drive methods for Raspberry Pi load or audio indication.
en.usable: Can turn old audio meters into slow status displays, with beginner-oriented analysis.
works_for: Separately removable analog VU or low-voltage meters
Raspberry Pi PWM/DAC status output
not_for: Direct 3.3V/5V connection at unknown sensitivity
Precision or fast measurement
en.value: Encourages measuring a salvaged part before wiring it by appearance.
en.follow: Continue if sensitivity can be measured and limited; preserve rare complete equipment nondestructively.

resources.zh_note: 记录原 LCD 难点、按键、蜂鸣器、振动、电源和 PyBoard 选择。
resources.en_note: Documents the original LCD problem, controls, beeper, vibration, power and PyBoard choice.

zh.stage: 作者拆解 Motorola Advisor，复用外壳、按键、蜂鸣器和振动电机，计划用 PyBoard、MicroPython 与替代 LCD 重建联网设备。
zh.usable: 可作为坚固寻呼机外壳和交互件的拆解参考，完整功能未确认。
works_for: Motorola Advisor 外壳、按键、蜂鸣器和振动件
MicroPython 小型通知终端实验
not_for: 继续使用原 POCSAG 网络的通用方案
直接复用无资料原 LCD
zh.value: 把难复用和可复用部件明确分开，减少盲目逆向。
zh.follow: 有相同寻呼机且接受换屏换主板时继续；收藏完好设备不宜破坏。

en.stage: The author disassembles a Motorola Advisor and plans a PyBoard/MicroPython rebuild reusing the enclosure, keys, beeper and vibration motor with a replacement LCD.
en.usable: A useful teardown reference for the rugged enclosure and interface parts; complete function is unconfirmed.
works_for: Motorola Advisor enclosure, keys, beeper and vibration parts
Small MicroPython notification-terminal experiments
not_for: A universal route to continue original POCSAG service
Direct reuse of the undocumented original LCD
en.value: Separates reusable parts from the difficult display, reducing blind reverse engineering.
en.follow: Continue with the same pager if replacing screen and mainboard is acceptable; preserve complete collectible units.

resources.zh_note: 说明旧 Duke 外壳、树莓派、电池、HDMI、模式开关和计划功能。
resources.en_note: Describes the old Duke shell, Raspberry Pi, battery, HDMI, mode switch and planned functions.

zh.stage: 作者利用断线的原版 Xbox Duke 手柄外壳，计划塞入树莓派、电池、HDMI 与控制电路，连接电视玩复古游戏或串流。
zh.usable: 外壳空间和按键可作为便携主机原型，完成度不足。
works_for: 线缆损坏但按键外壳完整的 Xbox Duke 手柄
需要 HDMI 接电视的树莓派小主机
not_for: 保留原 Xbox 控制器功能的无损方案
要求自带屏幕的掌机
zh.value: 展示超大手柄外壳可容纳完整主机和电池。
zh.follow: 作为个人结构实验可继续；想直接玩游戏应选成熟掌机方案。

en.stage: The author uses an original Xbox Duke controller with a broken cable as an enclosure for a Raspberry Pi, battery, HDMI output and controls for retro games or streaming.
en.usable: The enclosure and controls offer a portable-console prototype, but completion is insufficient.
works_for: Xbox Duke controllers with failed cables but intact shell/buttons
Raspberry Pi systems intended to plug into a TV over HDMI
not_for: A nondestructive route retaining original Xbox-controller function
A handheld with its own screen
en.value: Shows that the oversized controller shell can contain a whole computer and battery.
en.follow: Continue as a personal mechanical build; use a mature handheld platform for immediate gaming.

resources.zh_label: 作者项目与联网功能日志
resources.zh_note: 描述快门、Buildroot、PiCamera、Wi-Fi 热点、网页预览和图库。
resources.en_note: Describes shutter input, Buildroot, PiCamera, Wi-Fi access point, live view and gallery.

zh.stage: 作者把 Pi 相机与定制 Buildroot 系统装入旧相机，保留快门操作，并提供 Wi-Fi 热点、实时预览和照片图库。
zh.usable: 作者展示了可拍照和网页控制的工作路径，复刻需结构加工。
works_for: 机械结构完整、内部可容纳 Pi 的旧相机壳体
Pi Camera 与可调整传感器位置的改造
not_for: 直接让原胶片成像组件变成数码传感器
没有高压电容处理经验的闪光灯相机拆解
zh.value: 把保留原机操作手感、离线热点和照片管理组合成完整体验。
zh.follow: 有一台低收藏价值相机和结构加工能力时继续；稀有相机优先保存。

en.stage: The author installs a Pi camera and custom Buildroot system in an older camera, retaining shutter operation and adding a Wi-Fi hotspot, live view and photo gallery.
en.usable: The author demonstrates a working capture and web-control route that requires mechanical fabrication.
works_for: Low-value vintage enclosures with room for a Pi
Pi Camera builds with adjustable sensor placement
not_for: Directly turning original film imaging parts into a digital sensor
Opening flash cameras without high-voltage capacitor experience
en.value: Combines original tactile controls, an offline hotspot and photo management into a complete experience.
en.follow: Continue with a noncollectible camera and fabrication skills; preserve rare complete cameras.

resources.zh_label: 复用方法、转接板与模块清单
resources.en_label: Reuse method, adapter and camera list
resources.zh_note: 说明 USB 线路、常见 3.3V、电缆识别、Linux 工具和已复用摄像头列表。
resources.en_note: Covers USB lines, common 3.3 V power, cable identification, Linux tools and reused-camera records.

zh.stage: 项目说明许多笔记本摄像头本质上是 USB 设备，并设计 FPC 转接方案，整理多款已识别模块。
zh.usable: 很多明确识别的模块可成为小型 USB 摄像头。
works_for: 项目列表或数据表能确认 USB D+/D-/电源的模块
Linux UVC 可识别的笔记本摄像头
not_for: MIPI/专用接口模块
未知电压和引脚时直接试接
zh.value: 提供比单一教程更系统的识别流程和转接思路。
zh.follow: 能查到模块编号或测出 USB 线路时继续；无法识别则不要反复加电。

en.stage: The project explains that many laptop cameras are USB devices, develops an FPC adapter approach and records multiple identified modules.
en.usable: Many positively identified modules can become compact USB webcams.
works_for: Modules whose USB data and power pins are confirmed by lists or documentation
Laptop cameras recognized as Linux UVC devices
not_for: MIPI or proprietary-interface modules
Trial wiring with unknown voltage and pinout
en.value: Offers a broader identification process and adapter idea than a single one-off tutorial.
en.follow: Continue when the module number or USB lines can be identified; stop repeated power attempts on unknown hardware.

resources.zh_note: 说明原机故障、拆除、320×240 替换 LCD、树莓派与 Arduino 重建。
resources.en_note: Describes the failure, gutting, 320×240 replacement LCD, Raspberry Pi and Arduino rebuild.

zh.stage: 作者在迷你 Galaga 街机故障后拆除原电路，换入同尺寸 LCD，并用树莓派、Arduino 等重建游戏与控制。
zh.usable: 可让外壳和控制件继续作为复古游戏机，但原硬件功能被替换。
works_for: 作者同类迷你 Galaga 柜体
原板故障但外壳、按钮仍可用的低压迷你街机
not_for: 要求保留原板收藏价值
大型 CRT 街机直接照搬
zh.value: 说明何时跳过难以逆向的显示器、直接采用同尺寸替换件。
zh.follow: 低价值坏机可跟进；稀有原机先做可逆诊断与保存。

en.stage: After a Galaga mini cabinet fails, the author removes its electronics, fits a same-size LCD and rebuilds game/control functions with Raspberry Pi and Arduino components.
en.usable: Keeps the enclosure and controls useful as a retro machine while replacing original electronics.
works_for: The author's class of Galaga mini cabinet
Low-voltage mini arcades with failed boards but usable shell/buttons
not_for: Preserving original-board collector value
Directly copying the method to full-size CRT arcades
en.value: Shows when replacing a difficult display is more practical than reverse engineering it.
en.follow: Follow for a low-value failed unit; diagnose and preserve rare original hardware first.

resources.zh_note: 明确非官方支持、型号差异、服务器定位、散热和期望边界。
resources.en_note: States unofficial support, variant differences, server role, cooling and expectation boundaries.

zh.stage: Armbian 论坛 FAQ 明确把电视盒路线定位为社区实验，建议更适合无头 Linux 服务器而非桌面替代。
zh.usable: 部分盒子可从 SD/USB 启动成为低成本服务器，但外设常不完整。
works_for: 论坛有同板报告的 Amlogic 盒子
只需以太网、USB 和无头服务的实验
not_for: 把零售型号当作统一硬件
要求官方更新、完整 Wi-Fi/蓝牙/视频加速的主力机
zh.value: 论坛把风险和合理用途说得很清楚，可避免把盒子误当稳定 SBC。
zh.follow: 有串口/备份并接受试验性质时继续；重要服务选正式支持 SBC。

en.stage: The Armbian forum FAQ explicitly frames TV-box use as a community experiment and recommends headless Linux-server roles rather than desktop replacement.
en.usable: Some boxes can boot from SD/USB as low-cost servers, often with incomplete peripherals.
works_for: Amlogic boxes with same-board forum reports
Experiments needing Ethernet, USB and headless services only
not_for: Treating a retail name as one hardware configuration
Primary systems needing official updates and complete wireless/video acceleration
en.value: The forum states both sensible use and failure boundaries, preventing TV boxes from being mistaken for supported SBCs.
en.follow: Continue with serial access/backup and experimental expectations; use a supported SBC for important services.

resources.zh_note: 记录第二台机器、Armbian、简单 ZFS NAS、Wi-Fi 状态和不同存储/无线变体。
resources.en_note: Records the second unit, Armbian, simple ZFS NAS, Wi-Fi state and storage/wireless variants.

zh.stage: 论坛用户报告第二台 T95Z Plus 运行 Armbian，并用 ZFS 池做简单 NAS，同时记录 Wi-Fi 不工作和内部变体。
zh.usable: 作者的具体变体能做简单头less NAS，但无线和硬件一致性差。
works_for: 与报告相同 PCB/存储的 T95Z Plus
有线网络和 USB 存储的非关键实验 NAS
not_for: 只凭八角外壳判断兼容
保存唯一数据或依赖 Wi-Fi 的 NAS
zh.value: 提供一个具体可用结果，同时直接证明同名硬件有差异。
zh.follow: 能核对内部并接受数据实验风险时继续；重要存储选可维护硬件。

en.stage: A forum user reports a second T95Z Plus running Armbian and a ZFS pool as a simple NAS, while recording failed Wi-Fi and internal variants.
en.usable: The reported variant serves as a basic headless NAS, with poor wireless and hardware consistency.
works_for: T95Z Plus units matching the reported PCB/storage
Noncritical wired-network NAS experiments with USB storage
not_for: Assuming compatibility from the octagonal shell
Unique data or Wi-Fi-dependent storage
en.value: Provides a concrete working result while proving variation under the same product name.
en.follow: Continue after internal identification and with disposable data; use maintainable hardware for important storage.

resources.zh_label: VCF 开发讨论帖（本轮直接访问 503）
resources.zh_note: 搜索缓存显示矩阵、Apple/OSI 接口、样机、键帽与社区讨论；论坛恢复后需重新直接阅读。
resources.en_note: Search cache shows matrices, Apple/OSI interfaces, prototype photos, keycaps and discussion; reread directly after the forum recovers.

zh.stage: 作者在 VCF 论坛公开可组合键盘矩阵和接口板，目标替代难找的 Apple II、OSI 等复古电脑键盘，并展示工作样机。
zh.usable: 对已覆盖机器可获得外观和手感更接近原机的新键盘。
works_for: 帖子和项目文件明确覆盖的 Apple II、OSI 等机器
复古电脑修复和复制机
not_for: 任意老电脑的万能键盘
不核对接口电平就接主板
zh.value: 解决原装键盘缺失这一常见复活瓶颈，并保留社区讨论过程。
zh.follow: 准确机型有对应接口时继续；稀有原键盘先修复保存。

en.stage: The author shares modular keyboard matrices and interface boards on the VCF forum to replace scarce Apple II, OSI and other vintage keyboards, including a working prototype.
en.usable: Covered systems can receive a new keyboard closer to the original feel and layout.
works_for: Apple II, OSI and other systems explicitly covered by the thread/files
Vintage-computer restoration and replicas
not_for: A universal keyboard for every old computer
Connecting without checking interface voltage
en.value: Addresses a common restoration blocker—missing original keyboards—while retaining the community development record.
en.follow: Continue when an exact machine has a matching interface; repair and preserve rare original keyboards first.

resources.zh_label: 作者社区发布与反馈帖
resources.en_label: Author community release and feedback thread
resources.zh_note: 说明 Android 范围、32 位、Home Assistant 自动发现、BLE Proxy 和早期用户反馈。
resources.en_note: States Android range, 32-bit support, Home Assistant discovery, BLE Proxy and early feedback.

zh.stage: 作者发布 Android 7–16、含 32 位支持的 Ava 改版，让闲置设备成为 HA 语音/控制面板，并加入 BLE Proxy 网关。
zh.usable: 可尝试把仍能装 APK 的旧设备变成本地面板，低端机支持是作者主张。
works_for: Android 7–16 且能安装作者发布 APK 的闲置设备
Home Assistant 局域网内的面板与 BLE 覆盖实验
not_for: 无法安全长期供电的老化电池设备
要求已证明多年稳定的关键家庭控制
zh.value: 把显示、语音和 BLE 三种旧手机价值合在一条路线。
zh.follow: 用备用设备短期试运行并观察权限/耗电；关键控制保留替代入口。

en.stage: The author releases an Ava variant for Android 7–16 including 32-bit devices, turning spares into Home Assistant voice/control panels with a BLE Proxy gateway.
en.usable: A trial path for spare devices that can still install the APK; low-end support is an author claim.
works_for: Spare Android 7–16 devices able to install the author release
Panel and BLE-coverage experiments on a Home Assistant LAN
not_for: Aged batteries that cannot be powered safely
Critical home control requiring proven multi-year stability
en.value: Combines display, voice and BLE roles into one old-phone route.
en.follow: Pilot on a spare device and observe permissions/power; retain another control path for critical functions.

resources.zh_note: 展示拆除 LCD、保留背光和扩散层、重装便携灯板的全过程。
resources.en_note: Shows LCD removal, preserved backlight/diffusers and reassembly as a portable light table.

zh.stage: 教程移除破损液晶层，保留扩散片和 CCFL/LED 背光，把不能显示图像的屏幕组件变成绘图灯板。
zh.usable: 当 LCD 破裂但背光完好时，可恢复为透光绘图工具。
works_for: 背光和扩散层完整的坏笔记本屏幕
能保留或安全替换原背光驱动的模块
not_for: 背光也损坏或扩散膜污染严重
不熟悉 CCFL 高压的人拆老屏
zh.value: 不需要匹配视频控制板，能利用显示失败但照明仍好的部件。
zh.follow: LED 背光低压方案更适合继续；CCFL 模块先评估高压风险。

en.stage: The tutorial removes the broken liquid-crystal layer while retaining diffuser sheets and CCFL/LED backlight, turning a non-imaging screen assembly into a drawing light table.
en.usable: A panel with failed LCD but working backlight can become a tracing/drawing tool.
works_for: Broken laptop screens with intact backlight and diffuser layers
Modules whose original backlight driver can be retained or safely replaced
not_for: Failed backlights or badly contaminated optical films
Opening CCFL panels without high-voltage experience
en.value: Avoids a video controller and uses the illumination portion when image production is no longer possible.
en.follow: Low-voltage LED backlights are better candidates; assess CCFL high-voltage risk first.

resources.zh_note: 说明拆屏、按型号匹配控制板、电源、视频输入和外壳选择。
resources.en_note: Covers panel removal, model-specific controller, power, video input and enclosure choices.

zh.stage: 作者按面板型号购买对应控制板和电源，把拆下的笔记本 LCD 改成独立外接显示器。
zh.usable: 型号匹配时能成为 HDMI/DVI/VGA 等输入的显示器。
works_for: 面板本身正常且能找到精确匹配控制板的 LCD
愿意制作安全外壳和固定支架的用户
not_for: 破裂 LCD 或无法读取面板编号
把 30/40 针和 LVDS/eDP 当作可互换
zh.value: 是最直接、最普遍的笔记本部件复用之一。
zh.follow: 先确认面板编号和控制板固件；匹配不确定就不要下单。

en.stage: The author buys a controller and power supply matched to the panel number, turning a removed laptop LCD into a standalone external display.
en.usable: With a correct match, the panel can accept HDMI/DVI/VGA or similar standard inputs.
works_for: Working LCDs with an exact compatible controller
Users able to build a safe enclosure and mount
not_for: Cracked LCDs or panels without readable identifiers
Treating 30/40-pin and LVDS/eDP as interchangeable
en.value: One of the most direct and broadly useful laptop-part reuse routes.
en.follow: Confirm panel number and controller firmware first; do not order when matching is uncertain.

resources.zh_note: 覆盖拆机、屏幕、天线、摄像头、扬声器、木工、遥控和电池风险步骤。
resources.en_note: Covers teardown, display, antennas, camera, speakers, woodworking, remote and risky battery work.

zh.stage: 30 步教程复用笔记本主板、IPS 屏、Wi-Fi 天线、摄像头和扬声器，重新制作木质机身与遥控媒体电脑。
zh.usable: 主板和屏幕仍工作时，可高度复用整机部件做固定媒体终端。
works_for: 屏幕、主板和扬声器尚可工作的旧笔记本
能制作机箱和重新布置散热的制作者
not_for: 主板或屏幕已损坏的机器
没有锂电安全经验却照搬电池步骤
zh.value: 比只拆屏更充分地复用原机部件，并给出完整机械过程。
zh.follow: 先做无电池插电版本；功能和温度稳定后再完善外壳。

en.stage: A thirty-step build reuses a laptop motherboard, IPS display, Wi-Fi antennas, camera and speakers in a new wooden enclosure with media controls.
en.usable: When the board and screen work, many original parts can become a fixed media terminal.
works_for: Older laptops with working display, board and speakers
Builders able to fabricate an enclosure and redesign cooling
not_for: Machines with failed motherboard or panel
Copying battery-pack work without lithium safety experience
en.value: Reuses more of the original machine than a panel-only conversion and documents the full mechanical process.
en.follow: Start adapter-powered without the battery; finish the enclosure after function and temperature remain stable.

resources.zh_note: 说明回收屏、控制板、树莓派、浏览器和木质壁挂结构。
resources.en_note: Describes the salvaged display, controller, Raspberry Pi, browser and wooden wall enclosure.

zh.stage: 作者用回收的笔记本 LCD、匹配控制板和树莓派制作壁挂 Google Calendar，手机更新后墙面自动显示。
zh.usable: 可成为家庭日程显示屏，但依赖云账号和网络。
works_for: 有匹配视频控制板的旧笔记本 LCD
能运行当前浏览器的树莓派或小主机
not_for: 要求完全离线的家庭日历
把个人主账号永久登录在不受保护的显示器
zh.value: 提供一个清晰、日常可见的旧屏幕用途。
zh.follow: 使用独立只读账号和自动恢复后值得试；隐私要求高时用本地日历。

en.stage: The author uses a salvaged laptop LCD, matching controller and Raspberry Pi for a wall-mounted Google Calendar that follows phone updates.
en.usable: A practical household schedule display that depends on a cloud account and network.
works_for: Laptop LCDs with matched video controllers
Raspberry Pi or small hosts capable of a current browser
not_for: A fully offline household calendar
Leaving a personal primary account logged into an exposed display
en.value: Provides a clear everyday role for an otherwise unused screen.
en.follow: Worth trying with a separate read-only account and recovery; use local calendars when privacy is critical.

resources.zh_label: 八步 CNC 改造教程
resources.zh_note: 记录旧机测试、机械重构、独立主轴和初步加工路线。
resources.en_note: Documents old-machine testing, mechanical changes, separate spindle and initial machining route.

zh.stage: 作者测试闲置打印机三轴后，拆除挤出系统、增加独立主轴和刀具，把运动平台改作轻型切削。
zh.usable: 可做泡沫、蜡、软木等轻加工实验，不应假定能铣金属。
works_for: 机械结构仍可靠的闲置笛卡尔打印机
低负载软材料雕刻与学习
not_for: 金属重切削或无人值守
结构松动、线路暴露且无急停的机器
zh.value: 复用三轴运动系统，但也明确展示机械用途改变后的限制。
zh.follow: 有机加工防护并接受轻切削时继续；普通打印机能修好时先修复。

en.stage: The author tests the idle printer's three axes, removes extrusion hardware and adds a separately powered spindle and tool for light cutting.
en.usable: A learning route for foam, wax, soft wood and other light work, not assumed metal milling.
works_for: Idle Cartesian printers with reliable mechanics
Low-load engraving and learning on soft materials
not_for: Heavy metal cutting or unattended operation
Loose mechanisms or exposed wiring without emergency stop
en.value: Reuses the three-axis platform while exposing the limits caused by changing the machine's process.
en.follow: Continue with machining safeguards and light-cut expectations; repair a still-useful printer first.

resources.zh_note: 记录旧 Acer、1GB 内存、U 盘安装和电视媒体中心目标；软件已过时。
resources.en_note: Records an old Acer, 1 GB RAM, USB installation and TV-media-center goal; software is obsolete.

zh.stage: 旧教程让一台 1GB 内存 Acer 笔记本通过 OpenELEC/XBMC 从 U 盘启动并连接电视，说明低规格设备曾可承担 HTPC。
zh.usable: 作为历史方法可帮助判断旧笔记本是否适合离线本地媒体。
works_for: 能稳定启动、带可用视频输出的旧 x86 笔记本
主要播放本地低码率媒体的场景
not_for: 直接安装教程中的旧镜像联网使用
期待所有现代流媒体和 4K 解码
zh.value: 保存最简单的整机复用路线，同时提醒软件时代已经变化。
zh.follow: 先用当前系统做硬解码与安全更新测试；不合格则转成离线播放或其他用途。

en.stage: A historical guide boots OpenELEC/XBMC from USB on a 1 GB Acer laptop connected to a television, showing that low-spec hardware once served as an HTPC.
en.usable: Useful as a historical pattern for deciding whether an old laptop can play local offline media.
works_for: Stable older x86 laptops with usable video output
Mostly local lower-bitrate media playback
not_for: Installing the guide's old image on a network today
Expecting all modern streaming services and 4K decode
en.value: Preserves the simplest whole-machine reuse route while making the outdated software boundary visible.
en.follow: Test current software, hardware decode and updates first; fall back to offline playback or another role.

resources.zh_note: 说明 Samsung S5、第三方应用、账号、远程查看和简易支架。
resources.en_note: Describes the Samsung S5, third-party app/account, remote viewing and simple mount.

zh.stage: 作者把旧 Samsung S5 作为摄像端，通过当时的第三方应用和账号在另一台手机查看宠物画面。
zh.usable: 旧手机相机和 Wi-Fi 足够时可做临时宠物监控，具体应用路线可能过时。
works_for: 摄像头、Wi-Fi 和应用商店仍工作的闲置手机
短期、非关键的室内观察
not_for: 安全关键监控或秘密录制
电池异常、系统无法更新的长期无人值守设备
zh.value: 展示零额外相机硬件的快速验证方式，也暴露云服务依赖。
zh.follow: 先用本地、可审计应用短期测试；关键监控使用受维护设备。

en.stage: The author uses an old Samsung S5 as the camera endpoint and views a pet from another phone through a third-party app and account available at the time.
en.usable: A spare phone with working camera and Wi-Fi can provide temporary pet monitoring, though the specific app route may be obsolete.
works_for: Spare phones with functioning camera, Wi-Fi and app installation
Short-term noncritical indoor observation
not_for: Security-critical surveillance or covert recording
Unattended long-term use of unsafe batteries or unpatched systems
en.value: Demonstrates a no-extra-camera pilot while exposing dependence on a cloud service.
en.follow: Pilot briefly with a local auditable app; use maintained devices for critical monitoring.

resources.zh_note: 展示 TG585 外壳、LED、开关、电源口和可拆原型板安装。
resources.en_note: Shows the TG585 case, LEDs, switch, power jack and removable prototype-board mounting.

zh.stage: 作者复用故障 Thomson TG585 路由器外壳、开关、LED 和电源接口，装入自制家居自动化原型。
zh.usable: 可快速得到带指示灯、按钮和易开盖的低压项目外壳。
works_for: 故障但外壳完整的低压路由器
Arduino、传感器或门铃接口等低压原型
not_for: 希望继续使用原路由器网络功能
把未知原电源板直接接入新项目
zh.value: 低难度复用外壳和人机接口，适合大量常见电子废件。
zh.follow: 确认低压与绝缘后值得做；原路由器还能修复时优先修复整机。

en.stage: The author reuses a failed Thomson TG585 router case, switch, LEDs and power connector to house a home-automation prototype.
en.usable: Provides a low-voltage enclosure with indicators, button and easy access.
works_for: Failed low-voltage routers with intact cases
Arduino, sensor or doorbell-interface prototypes
not_for: Retaining original router networking function
Connecting an unknown original power board directly to the new project
en.value: A low-complexity way to reuse common enclosures and interfaces from electronic waste.
en.follow: Worth doing after low-voltage and insulation checks; repair the whole router first if it remains viable.
